text: Without a doubt the worst McDonald's restaurant in Leeds City Centre. The facilities are a joke, toilets smell horrible not to mention they cannot even keep the serviettes aduateley stocked. We ordered five different types of meals/burgers (without any special requirements or adjustments) and not one came with a pickle. When I questioned the staff they're only answer was to request a receipt (which we didn't get as the receipt printer was out of order - which is pretty much standard, don't think I've ever had a receipt printer work properly) to try embarrass me into a situation where I didn't order pickles, as if I were some sort of a moron that complains about not getting pickles when I asked for no pickles. Absolutely fed up of the increasingly poor service from McDonald's, only went here as Burger King was closed. Disappointed too many times now, never again.
author: Richard Frank

text: I bought two Big Mac yesterday 19/12/24 using the app. I collected as take away and only one patty was on each of them. I went to there to complain because I think that was deliberate but the manager said he needed a proof of purchase from the shop. With all the information I showed him on the app and transaction code from McDonalds when they collected the money he still said they didn’t show I came to there. What else did he want? I didn’t go begging for food but to get an explanation. I’m decent enough and working so I can afford McDonalds .
author: Francis Owusu

text: The Service in this McDonald’s is appalling! I ordered food and payed with a 20 pound note, they gave my change and I received a Scottish 10 pound note. I wasn’t happy and asked them to change it back, they wouldn’t so I ordered some more food and tried to pay with the money they gave me , they wouldn’t accept it saying I could not spend it here so I said may I speak to the person who gave me it, he claimed he did not remember who he gave it too, if you can I would recommend NOT going anywhere near this place.
author: Lexi Webster

text:
An experience never to be repeated.
Filthy and I mean filthy.
I had just sat down upstairs when a street begged sat down with us and asked for money.
I said no and asked him to leave he was menacing and my grandson was afraid. He eventually moved on to the next table to pester the people there.
There were a couple of staff members but no one asked him to leave.
I only ordered a coffee which was lukewarm.
Dreadful food
Dreadful place
Avoid
